transcript.en: Hello. My name is Damon and I would like to share my experiences of Oceanic Island Traveling.
transcript.zh: 大家好。我的名字是戴蒙。我想分享我的关于大洋岛旅行社的经历。

transcript.en: First of all, some of you have been asking me how Oceanic Island Traveling keeps its tour group members updated while they are on the travel trip.
transcript.zh: 首先，一些游客一直在问我，大洋岛旅行社如何让旅行团成员在旅行时得知信息更新。

transcript.en: Please note that the information board is updated daily and we encourage you to check it every morning before you begin your day on the beach, in the cottage, or participating in any of the many activities offered, so please remember to check it at the reception area in the front of the visitor center of the resort.
transcript.zh: 请注意，信息板每天都会更新，我们建议您每天早上在去海滩、小屋或参加提供的许多活动之前查看它，因此，请记得查看度假村游客中心前面的接待处区域。

transcript.en: You are probably aware of the many different activities offered on our trips.
transcript.zh: 您可能知道我们旅行中提供的许多不同的活动。

transcript.en: There is something you should know before booking.
transcript.zh: 在预订之前您应该了解一些事项。

transcript.en: Reservations are not necessary for most activities, such as sand soccer, beach volleyball, and even scuba diving.
transcript.zh: 大多数活动都不需要预订，例如沙滩足球、沙滩排球，甚至是水肺潜水。

transcript.en: However, if you are planning to participate in our water-skiing activity, we encourage you to book that activity at least 48 hours beforehand, as we hire an outside group to conduct this activity and we need to notify them of how many participants will be involved.
transcript.zh: 但是，如果您计划参加我们的滑水活动，我们建议您至少提前 48 小时预订该活动，因为我们聘请了外部团体来带领此活动，我们需要通知他们将有多少参与者。

transcript.en: One of the many activities available to the guests is the Mystery Cave Tour.
transcript.zh: 神秘洞穴之旅是旅客可以参加的众多活动之一。

transcript.en: Some people interested in participating in those tours don’t know what the ticket price includes.
transcript.zh: 一些有兴趣参加这些游览旅行的人不清楚票价包括哪些方面。

transcript.en: The ticket price includes transportation to the caves.
transcript.zh: 门票价格包括前往洞穴的交通费。

transcript.en: All participants are required to wear a safety helmet inside the caves and the ticket has covered that for you.
transcript.zh: 所有参与者都必须在洞穴内佩戴安全头盔，费用已含在门票内。

transcript.en: If you are joining this tour, you will need to wear some comfortable shoes, as there will be some walking involved with this tour.
transcript.zh: 如果您参加这趟游览，您需要穿舒适的鞋子，因为这次游览有一些步行。

transcript.en: If you are interested to see a map of the Mystery Cave in advance of your trip, you can see it on the Oceanic Island Traveling website.
transcript.zh: 如果您有兴趣在旅行出发前查看神秘洞穴的地图，可以在大洋岛旅行社网站上查看。

transcript.en: Of course, we will offer you a map of the cave if you need it during the tour, but it will cost an extra fee.
transcript.zh: 当然，如果您在游览过程中需要洞穴地图，我们会提供给您，但需要额外付费。

transcript.en: For those of you interested in visiting the Davison Wildlife Park, you should know that the park is an excellent site for families, though it does attract a lot of zoologists to do some research.
transcript.zh: 对于有兴趣参观戴维森野生动物园的游客来说，您应该知道这个公园是一个非常适合家庭游览的地方，尽管它也确实吸引了很多动物学家来做一些研究。

transcript.en: Again, transportation to the park is included in your ticket price.
transcript.zh: 同样，到公园的交通费用包含在您的票价中。

transcript.en: And please note that children aged 12 and under receive a discounted ticket price.
transcript.zh: 请注意，12 岁及以下的儿童可享受折扣票价。

transcript.en: In the wildlife park, children can often watch elephant shows which are really an attraction, but now some elephants are ill and they need some time to recover.
transcript.zh: 在野生动物园里，孩子们一般可以观看大象表演，真的很吸引人，但现在有些大象生病了，需要一段时间才能恢复。

transcript.en: Still there is another activity that should entertain kids—they are allowed to feed the animals.
transcript.zh: 还有另一项活动应该会让孩子们开心——他们可以喂动物。

transcript.en: This activity is extremely popular with kids.
transcript.zh: 这项活动非常受孩子们欢迎。

transcript.en: Among the most popular animals at the zoo are the collection of red kangaroos.
transcript.zh: 动物园里最受欢迎的动物之一是红袋鼠。

transcript.en: The size of these kangaroos is similar to that of black bears, but generally they are bigger than adults and, if you’re lucky, you might even be able to see some baby kangaroos while you are visiting.
transcript.zh: 这些袋鼠的体型和黑熊差不多，但一般都比成人体形大，如果运气好的话，您还可以在参观的时候看到一些小袋鼠。

transcript.en: The crocodiles are also very popular at the wildlife park.
transcript.zh: 鳄鱼在野生动物园也很受欢迎。

transcript.en: These prehistoric animals have a lifespan of over 50 years.
transcript.zh: 这些史前动物的寿命超过 50 年。

transcript.en: A male crocodile can even be expected to live to the age of 80.
transcript.zh: 雄性鳄鱼甚至可以活到80岁。

transcript.en: You won’t get as close to the crocodiles as you will to some of the other animals in the park, as they are somewhat dangerous, you will be able to view these animals from a distance in their natural habitats.
transcript.zh: 你不能像接近公园里的一些其他动物那样靠近鳄鱼，因为它们有些危险，你会在距离它们的自然栖息地较远处观察这些动物。

transcript.en: For those of you that have previously participated in this tour, please know that some of the activities which were previously available are no longer available and have been replaced with new activities.
transcript.zh: 之前参加过本次活动的小伙伴们，请注意，之前有的一些活动已经没有了，取而代之的是新的活动。

transcript.en: The barbecue and the bonfire are now restricted by ordinance due to fire precautions in the area.
transcript.zh: 由于该地区的防火措施，烧烤和篝火现在受到规定限制。

transcript.en: Instead of going hiking on the hills, most of our tourists prefer to visit many of the gift shops in the area to buy souvenirs for themselves or for family and friends who are not on the tour.
transcript.zh: 我们的大多数游客不喜欢在山上徒步旅行，而是更喜欢参观该地区的礼品店，为自己或未同行的家人和朋友购买纪念品。

transcript.en: The emu farm, which has previously been a popular place to visit, is now temporarily closed for business.
transcript.zh: 曾经是热门景点的鸸鹋农场，现在暂停营业。

transcript.en: But newly available to you is a popular trip offered to the Nelson Cheese factory in which visitors can take a tour and learn all about the process of manufacturing cheese.
transcript.zh: 但是，最近提供的热门游览行程是尼尔森奶酪工厂，游客可以参观并了解制造奶酪的所有过程。

transcript.en: And finally, a visit to the St. John’s Fruit Farm is another very popular day trip.
transcript.zh: 最后，圣约翰果园一日游是也非常受欢迎。

transcript.en: The fruit farm is within walking distance of our cottages and you can get there by minibus this time, but we’ll have a few nature trails that go past the cottages in the future.
transcript.zh: 果园就在我们小屋的步行距离之内，这次你可以乘坐小巴到达那里，但我们将来会有一些经过小屋的自然小径。

transcript.en: At the farm, you will be able to pick strawberries and apples in the farm’s orchards and fields.
transcript.zh: 在农场，您可以在农场的果园和田野里采摘草莓和苹果。

transcript.en: Many tourists enjoy this activity a lot.
transcript.zh: 很多游客都非常喜欢这项活动。

transcript.en: We don’t have hill hiking in the area, but we do have tours that involve in other destinations, contact me if you are interested.
transcript.zh: 我们在该地区没有爬山活动，但我们确实有涉及其他目的地的旅程，如果您有兴趣，请联系我。
